nodes.description: Privileged owner address set in constructor, gates delegate, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress.
Public mapping of token balances mutated with raw unchecked arithmetic.
Public nested mapping of spender allowances, decremented without SafeMath in transferFrom.
Whitelist mapping that bypasses the sale condition check in ensure().
Whitelisted trade address that bypasses ensure() checks.
Token supply set in constructor from user supplied _supply.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom, limits sell count.
Global sale limit configured by owner via init().
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender.
Public payable core transfer logic performing raw allowance and balance subtraction.
Internal whitelist gate containing owner, UNI pair, tradeAddress and canSale bypasses.
Internal sale limit / min / max value check used by ensure.
Owner-only function executing arbitrary delegatecall into caller supplied address and data.
Privileged mint function with hardcoded alternate privileged address, sets balances and canSale.
Owner-only sale parameter initialization.
Owner-only batch distribution computing total via unchecked multiplication.
Owner-only setter for the trade whitelist address.
Public payable approval writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Deploys token, assigns owner and total supply to msg.sender.
Caller controlled address used for ownership checks and allowance/balance ownership.
Low level delegatecall into an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value executes without SafeMath overflow protection.
uint total = _value * _tos.length can overflow silently.
balanceOf additions/subtractions performed with raw arithmetic allowing overflow/underflow.
Source address parameter of transferFrom and ensure.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom.
Value parameter of transfer, transferFrom, ensure and batchSend.

Calldata bytes parameter of delegate.

Loop index over _tos in batchSend.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared with _from to decide allowance spending and ownership.
delegate requires msg.sender to equal owner.
_mints requires msg.sender to equal owner or a hardcoded privileged address.
init requires msg.sender to equal owner.
batchSend requires msg.sender to equal owner.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender to equal owner.
approve keys allowance by msg.sender as owner of funds.
transfer uses msg.sender as the source of the forwarded transferFrom call.
delegate executes the low level delegatecall unsafe operation.
user supplied address a becomes the delegatecall target.
user supplied bytes b becomes the delegatecall calldata.
_value is subtracted from allowance without overflow protection.
_value participates in raw balanceOf subtraction and addition.
_from indexes balanceOf for unchecked decrement.
_to indexes balanceOf for unchecked increment.
_tos.length multiplies _value to build total without SafeMath.
_value is the multiplicand of the unchecked total computation.
batchSend performs the unchecked multiplication producing total.
local total feeds the unchecked balance arithmetic in batchSend.
batchSend mutates balanceOf without SafeMath.
transferFrom performs the raw allowance decrement.
transferFrom performs the raw balanceOf arithmetic.
transferFrom calls ensure before mutating balances.
ensure calls condition when the address is not whitelisted.
_from is forwarded into ensure for whitelist and condition evaluation.
_value is forwarded into ensure and compared against sale bounds.
computed _UNI pair address is used in the ensure whitelist comparison.
owner address short-circuits ensure returning true without condition checks.
tradeAddress short-circuits ensure returning true.
canSale[_from] short-circuits ensure returning true.
_saleNum is compared with _onSaleNum in condition.
_onSaleNum[_from] is read in condition.
_from keys the _onSaleNum counter lookup in condition.
_value is gated against _minSale and _maxSale owner configured limits.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no zero address or race protection.
_spender is used as the allowance mapping key.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] for any privileged caller.
spender keys the balanceOf write in _mints.
addedValue is scaled by 10**decimals and written unchecked.
_mints grants canSale[spender] = true bypassing sale restrictions.
spender keys the canSale whitelist write.
setTradeAddress writes the whitelist address used by ensure.
addr parameter becomes the new tradeAddress value.
constructor sets owner to msg.sender.
init writes the _saleNum sale limit.
loop index i iterates over _tos in batchSend.
each loop iteration adds _value to balanceOf[_tos[i]].
constructor mints totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals without SafeMath.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is the source argument consumed only by transferFrom/ensure flow.
_to is the destination argument consumed only by transferFrom.
_value drives allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
_spender is the mapping key written by approve.
a is the arbitrary delegatecall target inside delegate.
b is the arbitrary delegatecall calldata inside delegate.
spender is the beneficiary written by _mints.
addedValue is the minted amount written by _mints.
_tos is the recipient array iterated in batchSend.
addr is the new whitelist address written by setTradeAddress.
total is produced by the unchecked multiplication operation in batchSend.
_UNI is only used in the ensure whitelist comparison.
i is only the loop counter of the batchSend balance updates.
